label: baseline-haiku
reply:
**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval.** The claims system confirmed that `stage_settlement` succeeded with status "pending_approval" and a payout of €600. A Veridia claims handler must still approve it before any payment is made.

**Facts recorded**
- Claim reference: baseline-haiku-CLM-02. Policy VER-1006, policyholder Yanis Moreau, who was the driver. Vehicle market value €11,000. Licence date 15 January 2025.
- Incident: 4 October 2026, at a roundabout. The customer braked too late and hit the car in front.
- Report date: 6 October 2026, from the email date.
- Fault: the customer admits fault.
- Other party: Mr. Henry, named in the email. No other details were given.
- Repair quote: €1,300, for the customer's own car, so this is a C2 (collision) claim.
- Documents provided: damage_photos.zip, repair_quote.pdf, accident_report_signed.pdf. Their contents were not opened.

**Reasoning**
- **Reporting:** reported 2 days after the incident, within the 5-day limit. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Coverage:** C2 (collision damage) is listed in the Policy Schedule, so it applies. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Exclusions:** nothing in the email suggests an exclusion. The email does not mention alcohol, drugs, racing, intent or wear. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Documents:** C2 with a third party requires photos, a repair quote and a signed accident report. All three were provided. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Deductible:** the standard C2 deductible is €300. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="1" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Young-driver surcharge:** the licence was held for less than 3 years on the incident date, so an extra €400 applies. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Not-at-fault waiver:** does not apply, because the customer admits fault. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- **Referral:** no referral is needed, because the claim is on time, the coverage is in the schedule and there is no possible exclusion. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>

**Amounts (from compute_settlement)**
- Total deductible: €700 (€300 standard plus €400 young-driver surcharge).
- Payout: €600 (repair cost €1,300 minus €700).
- Assessor required: No, because the repair cost is not above €1,500. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="2" name="contract.pdf"/>
- Payment is made within 15 days after a Veridia claims handler approves it. <cite document_id="2630#10255" pages="3" name="contract.pdf"/>

**Note for the handler:** the claims subagent reported that it could not open the contract. I checked the contract directly and the article-level rules above match the amounts it computed.

**Draft message to the customer**
> Dear Mr. Moreau,
>
> Thank you for reporting the accident of 4 October 2026 under policy VER-1006. We have received your damage photos, the repair quote and the signed accident report. Your claim (reference baseline-haiku-CLM-02) is now with our team for final review, and we will write to you again once that review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
